findings.summary: test_keys.h and test_certs.h Python-script codegen not represented in Bazel
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:335-364 creates add_custom_command rules that run generate_test_keys.py and generate_test_cert_macros.py (under framework/scripts/) to produce tests/src/test_keys.h and tests/src/test_certs.h, with mbedtls_test depending on them. Bazel has no equivalent genrule. The library targets carry 'has-cmake-codegen' for ssl_debug_helpers_generated.c but not for these test headers.

findings.summary: -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L missing — affects tests that use POSIX-extension symbols
findings.evidence: tests/CMakeLists.txt:319 calls add_definitions("-D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L") globally for the test tree to enable gethostname/strdup/fileno under -std=c99. No Bazel test target exists, so the define is not present; any future test targets would silently miss it.

findings.summary: GCC-only flags baked unconditionally — will break Clang builds
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt applies -Wlogical-op (≥4.5), -Wshadow (≥4.8), -Wformat-signedness (≥5.0), -Wformat-overflow=2, -Wformat-truncation (≥7.0) only when CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNU (lines 214-228). Bazel hardcodes all of them unconditionally in the copts of every cc_library (mbedcrypto, mbedtls, mbedx509). -Wlogical-op is unsupported on Clang and will cause a compile error with any Clang toolchain.

findings.summary: All program executables (ssl_server, ssl_client, dtls_*, etc.) missing from Bazel
findings.evidence: programs/ssl/CMakeLists.txt lists 10 SSL executables (lines 7-18); programs/pkey, psa, x509, aes, hash, random, cipher, util each define additional cc_binary targets. CMakeLists.txt:397-399 adds programs/ when ENABLE_PROGRAMS=ON (default). Bazel has only alias and pkg_files stubs — no cc_binary targets.

findings.summary: All test suite targets (test_suite_*) missing from Bazel
findings.evidence: tests/CMakeLists.txt defines an add_test_suite() function (line 191) and calls it for every *.data file found via file(GLOB) (line 331-342), generating ~80+ test executables registered with add_test(). No cc_test or sh_test targets exist anywhere in the Bazel workspace.

findings.summary: Clang global flags -Wpointer-arith and -Wimplicit-fallthrough not in Bazel copts
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:241 sets -Wpointer-arith and -Wimplicit-fallthrough for CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_CLANG. Bazel copts have no select() on compiler identity and omit both flags entirely, so Clang builds are silently weaker.

findings.summary: Clang library-level flags -Wdocumentation, -Wno-documentation-deprecated-sync, -Wunreachable-code absent from Bazel
findings.evidence: library/CMakeLists.txt:203-205 adds these three flags for CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_CLANG. The Bazel cc_library copts have no compiler-conditioned select() and omit all three.

findings.summary: pkg-config .pc prefix hardcoded to /usr/local instead of relocatable
findings.evidence: pkgconfig/CMakeLists.txt:3-4 uses JoinPaths.cmake to build PKGCONFIG_INCLUDEDIR/PKGCONFIG_LIBDIR relative to the install prefix (expanding @prefix@ at install time). The Bazel write_file rules hardcode 'prefix=/usr/local' unconditionally, breaking pkg-config for non-default install prefixes.

findings.summary: Everest target also requires MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE pass-through — missing in Bazel
findings.evidence: 3rdparty/everest/CMakeLists.txt:16-27 explicitly duplicates the config-file pass-through for the everest target because it is not transitively linked to the mbedtls libraries. The Bazel //elements/mbedtls/3rdparty/everest target carries no MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE define.

findings.summary: MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE / MBEDTLS_USER_CONFIG_FILE not expressible as Bazel compile definitions
findings.evidence: library/CMakeLists.txt:337-344 conditionally adds PUBLIC compile definitions MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE and MBEDTLS_USER_CONFIG_FILE to each library target when the corresponding CMake cache PATH variables are set. CMakeLists.txt:146-147 declares them as FILEPATH cache variables. Bazel has no equivalent select() or label_flag mechanism; the copts/defines lists are static.

CMakeLists.txt:334 creates an OBJECT library mbedtls_test from tests/src/*.c and tests/src/drivers/*.c, used as a shared test-utility base by every test suite and some programs. It is not present in any Bazel BUILD file.

findings.summary: AppleClang ranlib archive flags not applied in Bazel
findings.evidence: library/CMakeLists.txt:223-230 sets CMAKE_C_ARCHIVE_CREATE/FINISH to pass -no_warning_for_no_symbols -c to ranlib for AppleClang. Bazel delegates archiving entirely to its toolchain with no override hook; macOS builds will get spurious 'no symbols' ranlib warnings.

findings.summary: WIN32 link libraries ws2_32/bcrypt and Haiku 'network' not conditioned in Bazel
findings.evidence: library/CMakeLists.txt:219-221 adds ws2_32 and bcrypt for WIN32; lines 232-234 add 'network' for HAIKU. The Bazel cc_library targets have no select() on @platforms//os and omit these system libraries.

findings.summary: lcov (coverage) and memcheck (valgrind) convenience targets absent
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:420-430 defines ADD_CUSTOM_TARGET(lcov) and ADD_CUSTOM_TARGET(memcheck) for UNIX builds when ENABLE_TESTING is ON. No equivalent Bazel run target or sh_binary exists.
